# Perso

Perso is a light interface with a clear hierarchy expressed through distinct heading sizes, spacing and colors. Code snippets are styled to contrast with the surrounding text.

![Perso screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/behrouze/obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshots/theme-perso-obsidian.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Perso"
    author: "behrouze"
    repo:   "behrouze/obsidian-theme"
    slug:   "perso"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/perso"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/behrouze/obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/behrouze/obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshots/theme-perso-obsidian.png"

    modes: ["light"]
    about: "Apply a clean light interface with a clear hierarchy and distinct heading sizes, spacing, and colors. Make code snippets stand out with readable styling that contrasts them from surrounding text."
}
```
